player_prompt.intro:
Yin e jiäk Player {player_id} ee tuŋɛn ka Reverse Tic Tac Toe. Yin symbol e '{symbol}'.
E jiäk kä yinɛn ka wääräŋɛn ka thääräŋɛn (käthɛɛr, käwɛɛr, käŋulɛɛr).
Na yinɛn thääräŋɛn, yin LOSE.
Dhɔ̈ɔ̈r yinɛn kä wääräŋɛn ee format '[4]' ka yin symbol ee cell 4.
E Player {player_id}, yin e '{symbol}' ee yin dɔ̈ɔ̈r e '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mi̱ /ci̱ laar i̱ cɛ jɔɔc. La̱tdɛ kɛɛ '[cell]'.

game_action.placed: Player {player_id} dɔ̈ɔ̈r yin symbol ({symbol}) ee cell {cell}.

outcome.loss: Ji̱ ŋarä {player_id} ci kɛ bath mi cɛ la̱tdiɛn thuɔ̱k!
outcome.draw: Ɛ mi̱ /ci̱ rɔ lot, thilɛ ram kɛl mi̱ ci̱ bath.
